newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 11.48 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 11.48 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry sold on one- and four-week bills on Tuesday, yielding 3.80 percent and 17.76 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 11.479 billion levs of T-bills and the ministry approved all of them.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry. Auction dates and maturity dates for both issues overlap.
Bids received 6,313 million levs 5,165.5 million levs
Bids approved 6,313 million levs 5,165.5 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 3.80 pct 17.76 pct @
